INSERT INTO candidates (
  candidate_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  email,
  phone,
  linkedin_url,
  location_text,
  work_auth,
  years_experience,
  discipline,
  discipline_other,
  employed_status,
  notice_period_weeks,
  salary_expectation,
  work_preferences,
  summary_self,
  cv_text_pasted,
  cv_drive_url,
  cv_drive_id,
  cv_filename,
  cv_mime_type,
  headline,
  strengths,
  concerns_or_gaps,
  best_fit_role_types,
  niche_match_score,
  salary_realism,
  availability_signal,
  follow_up_questions,
  recommend_action,
  overall_market_fit,
  status,
  source,
  consent_given,
  consent_date,
  submitted_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.candidate_id }}',
  '{{ ($json.full_name.split(" ")[0] || "Unknown").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.full_name.split(" ").slice(1).join(" ") || "Unknown").replaceAll("'", "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.email.replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::citext,
  {{ $json.phone ? "'" + $json.phone.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.linkedin_url ? "'" + $json.linkedin_url.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.location ? "'" + $json.location.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.work_auth ? "'" + ({"Citizen":"citizen","Permanent Resident":"permanent_resident","Working Holiday":"working_holiday","482 / Sponsored":"482_sponsored","Student Visa":"student_visa","Other / Need sponsorship":"other_or_sponsorship"}[$json.work_auth] || "other_or_sponsorship") + "'::work_auth_status" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.years_experience ? "'" + ({"Less than 1 year":"less_than_1","1 year":"1_year","2 years":"2_years","3-5 years":"3_to_5","5-10 years":"5_to_10","10+ years":"10_plus"}[$json.years_experience] || "less_than_1") + "'::experience_band" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.discipline ? "'" + ($json.discipline.toLowerCase().replaceAll(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"_").replace(/^_|_$/g,"")) + "'::candidate_discipline" : 'NULL' }},
  NULL,
  {{ $json.employed_status ? "'" + ({"Yes, looking passively":"employed_passive","Yes, actively looking":"employed_active","No, available immediately":"available_immediate","No, available with notice":"available_with_notice"}[$json.employed_status] || "employed_passive") + "'::employment_status" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.notice_period_weeks ? parseInt($json.notice_period_weeks) : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.salary_expectation ? "'" + $json.salary_expectation.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.work_preferences ? "ARRAY[" + $json.work_preferences.split(',').map(s => "'" + s.trim().replaceAll("'", "''") + "'").join(',') + "]::text[]" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.summary_self ? "'" + $json.summary_self.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  NULL,
  {{ $json.cv_drive_url ? "'" + $json.cv_drive_url.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.cv_drive_id ? "'" + $json.cv_drive_id.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.cv_filename ? "'" + $json.cv_filename.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.cv_mime_type ? "'" + $json.cv_mime_type.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.headline ? "'" + $json.headline.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.strengths ? "'" + $json.strengths.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.concerns_or_gaps ? "'" + $json.concerns_or_gaps.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.best_fit_role_types ? "'" + $json.best_fit_role_types.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.niche_match_score || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.salary_realism ? "'" + $json.salary_realism.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.availability_signal ? "'" + $json.availability_signal.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.follow_up_questions ? "'" + $json.follow_up_questions.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.recommend_action ? "'" + $json.recommend_action.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.overall_market_fit ? "'" + $json.overall_market_fit.replaceAll("'", "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'new'::candidate_status,
  'web_form'::candidate_source,
  true,
  '{{ $json.submitted_at }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.submitted_at }}'::timestamptz
)
ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
  updated_at = now(),
  -- refresh AI screening fields on resubmission
  headline = EXCLUDED.headline,
  strengths = EXCLUDED.strengths,
  concerns_or_gaps = EXCLUDED.concerns_or_gaps,
  best_fit_role_types = EXCLUDED.best_fit_role_types,
  niche_match_score = EXCLUDED.niche_match_score,
  salary_realism = EXCLUDED.salary_realism,
  availability_signal = EXCLUDED.availability_signal,
  follow_up_questions = EXCLUDED.follow_up_questions,
  recommend_action = EXCLUDED.recommend_action,
  overall_market_fit = EXCLUDED.overall_market_fit,
  -- refresh CV fields if new ones provided (COALESCE keeps existing if new is empty)
  cv_drive_url = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cv_drive_url, ''), candidates.cv_drive_url),
  cv_drive_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cv_drive_id, ''), candidates.cv_drive_id),
  cv_filename = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cv_filename, ''), candidates.cv_filename),
  cv_mime_type = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.cv_mime_type, ''), candidates.cv_mime_type)
RETURNING id, candidate_id, email, full_name;

WITH candidate_lookup AS (
  SELECT id FROM candidates WHERE email = '{{ $('Insert Candidate (Postgres)').item.json.email }}'::citext
),
matches AS (
  SELECT m::jsonb AS j
  FROM jsonb_array_elements('{{ $('Parse Matches').item.json.top_matches_json.replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb) AS m
)
INSERT INTO job_candidates (job_id, candidate_id, match_score, match_reason, match_concerns, matched_by, status)
SELECT
  (j->>'job_id')::uuid,
  (SELECT id FROM candidate_lookup),
  COALESCE((j->>'match_score')::integer, 0),
  j->>'match_reason',
  NULLIF(j->>'concerns', ''),
  'ai',
  'matched'::candidate_job_status
FROM matches
WHERE (j->>'job_id') IS NOT NULL
  AND (j->>'job_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
ON CONFLICT (job_id, candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET
  match_score = EXCLUDED.match_score,
  match_reason = EXCLUDED.match_reason,
  match_concerns = EXCLUDED.match_concerns,
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, job_id, candidate_id, match_score;

SELECT
  j.id::text         AS job_id,
  j.role_title       AS role_title,
  c.name             AS company,
  COALESCE(j.location_city || ', ' || j.location_state::text, j.location_city, 'Unknown') AS location,
  j.salary_text      AS salary,
  j.status::text     AS contract_type,
  ''                 AS fifo,
  j.discipline       AS niche,
  j.pain_hypothesis  AS pain_hypothesis,
  j.score_band::text AS score_band,
  j.ai_score         AS ai_score
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id
WHERE j.score_band::text IN ('critical', 'hot')
  AND j.status NOT IN ('placed', 'closed_lost', 'rejected')
ORDER BY 
  CASE j.score_band::text WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'hot' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  j.discovered_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
